title: Crime & law (B1)
note: Course-doc theme. Basic crime and justice lexis: what happened, who did it, what follows. Strong passive feeder — pairs with b1_passives (He was arrested). First draft 2026-09-02. · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: sentences 8 → 36, one gappable frame per lemma. Three of the eight shipped frames could never gap (*stole*, *arrested*, *witnesses* against their base lemmas) — and *stole* was also this live unit's only audit violation, so it is gone. E10: Use is use_mode rewrite, 12 underlined paraphrases. F7: eleven tiles leaf_society_a2 and friends already own (crime, steal, attack, thief, lawyer, evidence, innocent, prison, law, illegal, drugs) moved to a **You already know** board, and the list was refilled with murder, robbery, vandalism, shoplifting, bribe, offence, court, verdict, defendant, appeal, convict. A12: four tiles are a second sense of a word the student already has — **fine (a penalty)** against A1's *fajn*, **sentence (in court)** against A1's *věta*, **charge (with a crime)** against leaf_money_b1's fee, **guilty (in court)** against leaf_self_b1's feeling. They keep their tiles with the sense marked, and an intro table puts the four pairs side by side. · Pool-checked against everything taught before leaf_crime_b1 — 0 unknown types. · 2026-09-04: six rewrite items re-cut so replacing the underline reconstructs the answer. · 2026-09-05 B1 loop: sentence texture. 23 of 36 Use sentences were FLAT or THIN under check_sentence_texture.py. All 23 rewritten to make one clause move and carry two or more already-taught words; the six own-lemma packs of this leaf (police, court, trial, fraud, officer, offence) do not count as recycling, so several items needed a second taught word as well as the clause. 0/36 fail now.

intro.title: Four words you know in a new sense
You will use these words in
frames: The … lasted three weeks · *… trval tři týdny*
intro.note: This pack feeds **b1_passives**: *He was arrested. The car was damaged. He was found guilty.* The passive is where these words actually live.
intro.note_cz: Tahle slova se často používají v trpném rodě (b1_passives).

blocks.title: Crime · the people and the process
Crime · the court and what follows

sentences.en: There was a burglary in our street last night, but nobody heard anything.
sentences.cz: Minulou noc došlo v naší ulici k vloupání, ale nikdo nic neslyšel.
accepts: There was a burglary in our street last night, but nobody heard anything

sentences.en: The bank robbery took four minutes and nobody was hurt.
sentences.cz: Ta bankovní loupež trvala čtyři minuty a nikdo nebyl zraněn.
accepts: The bank robbery took four minutes and nobody was hurt

sentences.en: Two young people tried to rob the shop, but the door was locked.
sentences.cz: Dva mladí lidé se pokusili vyloupit obchod, ale dveře byly zamčené.
accepts: Two young people tried to rob the shop, but the door was locked

sentences.en: The book is about a murder which nobody in the village saw.
sentences.cz: Ta kniha je o vraždě, kterou ve vesnici nikdo neviděl.
accepts: The book is about a murder which nobody in the village saw

sentences.en: The fire was arson, not an accident.
sentences.cz: Ten požár bylo žhářství, ne nehoda.
accepts: The fire was arson, not an accident

sentences.en: The company lost a lot of money in a fraud which lasted two years.
sentences.cz: Firma přišla o spoustu peněz podvodem, který trval dva roky.
accepts: The company lost a lot of money in a fraud which lasted two years

sentences.en: They tried to smuggle wine across the border because the tax is lower in Poland.
sentences.cz: Pokusili se pašovat víno přes hranici, protože je v Polsku nižší daň.
accepts: They tried to smuggle wine across the border because the tax is lower in Poland

sentences.en: Hacking is a crime, even when nothing is taken.
sentences.cz: Hackerský útok je trestný čin, i když se nic neukradne.
accepts: Hacking is a crime, even when nothing is taken

sentences.en: Vandalism in the park costs the city thousands, but nobody is ever caught.
sentences.cz: Vandalismus v parku stojí město tisíce, ale nikdy nikoho nechytí.
accepts: Vandalism in the park costs the city thousands, but nobody is ever caught

sentences.en: Shoplifting is the most common offence in the town centre.
sentences.cz: Krádeže v obchodech jsou v centru města nejčastější přestupek.
accepts: Shoplifting is the most common offence in the town centre

sentences.en: The storm did more damage than the insurance company will pay for.
sentences.cz: Ta bouře napáchala větší škody, než kolik pojišťovna zaplatí.
accepts: The storm did more damage than the insurance company will pay for

sentences.en: There was no violence, but the neighbours were still afraid.
sentences.cz: K násilí nedošlo, ale sousedi se stejně báli.
accepts: There was no violence, but the neighbours were still afraid

sentences.en: A police officer asked me where I was on Friday night, but I could not remember.
sentences.cz: Policista se mě zeptal, kde jsem byl v pátek večer, ale nemohl jsem si vzpomenout.
accepts: A police officer asked me where I was on Friday night, but I could not remember

sentences.en: The suspect was at work when the shop was robbed.
sentences.cz: Podezřelý byl v práci, když ten obchod vyloupili.
accepts: The suspect was at work when the shop was robbed

sentences.en: The witness said the car was blue, but the photos showed a green one.
sentences.cz: Svědek řekl, že to auto bylo modré, ale na fotkách bylo zelené.
accepts: The witness said the car was blue, but the photos showed a green one

sentences.en: The victim did not want to go to court because she was afraid.
sentences.cz: Oběť nechtěla jít k soudu, protože se bála.
accepts: The victim did not want to go to court because she was afraid

sentences.en: The judge listened to the family for two hours before he spoke.
sentences.cz: Soudce rodinu poslouchal dvě hodiny, než promluvil.
accepts: The judge listened to the family for two hours before he spoke

sentences.en: The jury needed two days to decide because the evidence was not clear.
sentences.cz: Porota potřebovala dva dny na rozhodnutí, protože důkazy nebyly jasné.
accepts: The jury needed two days to decide because the evidence was not clear

sentences.en: The defendant said nothing during the trial because his lawyer told him to stay quiet.
sentences.cz: Obžalovaný během procesu nic neřekl, protože mu právník řekl, ať mlčí.
accepts: The defendant said nothing during the trial because his lawyer told him to stay quiet

sentences.en: The police will arrest him if he goes home.
sentences.cz: Policie ho zatkne, jestli půjde domů.
accepts: The police will arrest him if he goes home
The police'll arrest him if he goes home

sentences.en: The investigation took six months because the office lost the first report.
sentences.cz: Vyšetřování trvalo šest měsíců, protože úřad ztratil první zprávu.
accepts: The investigation took six months because the office lost the first report

sentences.en: You have to report a crime in the first week, but many people never do.
sentences.cz: Trestný čin musíš nahlásit během prvního týdne, ale spousta lidí to nikdy neudělá.
accepts: You have to report a crime in the first week, but many people never do

sentences.en: The police will charge him with fraud if the bank finds the letters.
sentences.cz: Policie ho obviní z podvodu, pokud banka najde ty dopisy.
accepts: The police will charge him with fraud if the bank finds the letters

sentences.en: He tried to bribe the officer, but that made everything worse.
sentences.cz: Pokusil se toho policistu podplatit, ale tím všechno ještě zhoršil.
accepts: He tried to bribe the officer, but that made everything worse

sentences.en: The two families will meet in court because nobody wants to pay.
sentences.cz: Ty dvě rodiny se sejdou u soudu, protože nikdo nechce platit.
accepts: The two families will meet in court because nobody wants to pay

sentences.en: The trial lasted three weeks, but the verdict took one minute.
sentences.cz: Proces trval tři týdny, ale rozsudek zabral jednu minutu.
accepts: The trial lasted three weeks, but the verdict took one minute

sentences.en: The verdict surprised everybody in the room because the evidence was strong.
sentences.cz: Ten rozsudek všechny v místnosti překvapil, protože důkazy byly silné.
accepts: The verdict surprised everybody in the room because the evidence was strong

sentences.en: He was found guilty at the trial, but his family still believes him.
sentences.cz: U soudu byl shledán vinným, ale rodina mu pořád věří.
accepts: He was found guilty at the trial, but his family still believes him

sentences.en: The sentence was two years, but he came home after one.
sentences.cz: Trest byl dva roky, ale domů se vrátil po roce.
accepts: The sentence was two years, but he came home after one

sentences.en: She had to pay a large fine because she drove too fast in the village.
sentences.cz: Musela zaplatit vysokou pokutu, protože ve vesnici jela moc rychle.
accepts: She had to pay a large fine because she drove too fast in the village

sentences.en: The punishment for a first offence is a small fine, but the judge can send you to prison.
sentences.cz: Trest za první přestupek je malá pokuta, ale soudce tě může poslat do vězení.
accepts: The punishment for a first offence is a small fine, but the judge can send you to prison

sentences.en: His lawyer will appeal next month if the family finds the money.
sentences.cz: Jeho právník se příští měsíc odvolá, pokud rodina sežene peníze.
accepts: His lawyer will appeal next month if the family finds the money

sentences.en: They will release him in the spring if he is good.
sentences.cz: Na jaře ho propustí, jestli se bude chovat dobře.
accepts: They will release him in the spring if he is good

sentences.en: It is legal to park here after six, but the sign is hard to see.
sentences.cz: Parkovat tady po šesté je legální, ale ta značka je špatně vidět.
accepts: It is legal to park here after six, but the sign is hard to see

sentences.en: Driving after a drink is a serious offence.
sentences.cz: Řídit po alkoholu je vážný přestupek.
accepts: Driving after a drink is a serious offence

sentences.en: It is hard to convict anybody when there is no witness.
sentences.cz: Je těžké někoho odsoudit, když není žádný svědek.
accepts: It is hard to convict anybody when there is no witness
It's hard to convict anybody when there is no witness

use_hint: Rewrite the sentence. Replace the underlined words.

use_sentences.prompt: Two young people tried to take money from the shop on the corner.
use_sentences.en: Two young people tried to rob the shop on the corner.
accepts: Two young people tried to rob the shop on the corner

use_sentences.prompt: They tried to secretly take wine across the border.
use_sentences.en: They tried to smuggle wine across the border.
accepts: They tried to smuggle wine across the border

use_sentences.prompt: The police will come for him if he goes home.
use_sentences.en: The police will arrest him if he goes home.
accepts: The police will arrest him if he goes home

use_sentences.prompt: The person who saw it said the car was blue.
use_sentences.en: The witness said the car was blue.
accepts: The witness said the car was blue

use_sentences.prompt: The person who lost the money did not want to go to court.
use_sentences.en: The victim did not want to go to court.
accepts: The victim did not want to go to court
The victim didn't want to go to court

use_sentences.prompt: The decision of the jury surprised everybody in the room.
use_sentences.en: The verdict surprised everybody in the room.
accepts: The verdict surprised everybody in the room

use_sentences.prompt: She had to pay money to the police because she drove too fast.
use_sentences.en: She had to pay a fine because she drove too fast.
accepts: She had to pay a fine because she drove too fast

use_sentences.prompt: The thing the court gives you for a first offence is usually small.
use_sentences.en: The punishment for a first offence is usually small.
accepts: The punishment for a first offence is usually small

use_sentences.prompt: They will free him in the spring if he is good.
use_sentences.en: They will release him in the spring if he is good.
accepts: They will release him in the spring if he is good

use_sentences.prompt: It is allowed to park here after six in the evening.
use_sentences.en: It is legal to park here after six in the evening.
accepts: It is legal to park here after six in the evening
It's legal to park here after six in the evening

use_sentences.prompt: The work the police did took six months.
accepts: The investigation took six months

use_sentences.prompt: It is hard to punish anybody when there is no witness.
use_sentences.en: It is hard to convict anybody when there is no witness.
accepts: It is hard to convict anybody when there is no witness
It's hard to convict anybody when there is no witness
